hero_claim.scientific_basis_en: The synergistic combination of collagen, peptides, and Centella asiatica extract is supported by research demonstrating their roles in skin repair, collagen synthesis, and anti-aging mechanisms. Studies highlight Centella asiatica's ability to target oxidative stress and support skin regeneration, while collagen and peptides are fundamental for structural integrity and elasticity. (PMID: 42343000, 42280293, 42252897)
